subject: How to change appearance and position of "Progress {shiny}" bar and message display

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: How to change appearance and position of "Progress {shiny}" bar and message display
parts:
Hi,

I really like the new "Progress {shiny}" progress bar with object-oriented API. But it is too subtle, and I find users not realizing it's there all the time. Especially on large, high resolution monitors.

How may I make the message larger and center it in the window? Also, how may I make the progress bar at the top of the window thicker, and more visible?

Jonathan

messages.author: 4b7975197ab81295
messages.subject: Re: How to change appearance and position of "Progress {shiny}" bar and message display
parts:
Hi,

I know this is not the answer to your question but since you're working with progress bars I thought you might be able to help me, I need to add a progress bar for Uploading a file (big data), but I don't find a way to track this progress with functions like read.csv or read.csv.ffdf, if you have any idea of how can I achieve this I would be sincerely grateful.

Kind regards,
Danny.
